_notes.LFBO: Two options for the nav. As converted (runway groups airbus/other, selection, defaultStrategy nearest), the LFBO differences listed above (144 cases) are the price of `nearest` preferring the airbus runways. Without `selection` for the LFBO points (one implicit group, declaration order), v2 reproduces v1 on all but 8 cases (MEN, FINOT, LACOU, FISTO turboprops inside the airbus area at 14: v1 H 14R, v2 A 14L), but `nearest` then only enables the AMOLO A 14R area entry and no longer prefers the airbus runways. The conversion keeps the groups (spec 5.1); the nav chooses.
